cell_ref.description: One cell of the grid, by ZERO-BASED row and column: the cell written `A1` is {"row": 0, "col": 0}, `C7` is {"row": 6, "col": 2}.

col.description: Zero-based column index, 0..16383 (the grid has 16,384 columns; column 0 is `A`, 25 is `Z`, 26 is `AA`).

row.description: Zero-based row index, 0..1048575 (the grid has 1,048,576 rows).

color.description: A colour: automatic, an explicit RGB value, or a slot of the workbook theme with a tint.

oneOf.description: Automatic: black for text and lines, no fill for fills.

Rgb.description: 0xRRGGBB packed in one integer: red*65536 + green*256 + blue, each component 0..255, sRGB.

oneOf.description: A theme colour with a tint.

Theme.description: [slot, tint]. slot: index 0..255 into `theme.colors` of the styles node (0 = light 1 / background, 1 = dark 1 / text, 2 = light 2, 3 = dark 2, 4..9 = accent 1..6, 10 = hyperlink, 11 = followed hyperlink; a slot beyond 11 resolves to black). tint: -1000..1000 thousandths; 0 = the theme colour itself. To resolve: convert the theme colour to HSL; if tint < 0 then L' = L * (1 + tint/1000), else L' = L * (1 - tint/1000) + tint/1000; convert back to RGB.

range_ref.description: A rectangle of cells, both corners INCLUDED. `start` is the top-left corner and `end` the bottom-right one (start.row <= end.row and start.col <= end.col; a reader that finds them swapped swaps them back). A whole row spans columns 0..16383; a whole column spans rows 0..1048575.

description: One PivotTable (node type core.sheet.pivot): its DEFINITION. The report it produces is ordinary cell values on its sheet, written by the last refresh and stored with the sheet's cells; a reader that does not implement pivots still reads those values.

anchor.description: Top-left cell of the report body on the pivot's sheet.

calculated_fields.description: Calculated fields, usable in the Values area by name.

items.description: One calculated field. It is evaluated on the SUMS of the fields it names, per report cell.

formula.description: Its formula, starting with `=`, e.g. `=Sales*0.1`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

name.description: Its name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

columns.description: Fields in the Columns area, outermost first.

items.description: A field placed in the Rows or Columns area.

collapsed_items.description: Labels of the items whose detail is hidden.

items.description: One item label. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

date_group.description: Grouping of a date field (the values are date serial numbers).

sort.description: Order of the items; None = order of first appearance in the source.

source_col.description: Header name of the source column. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

filters.description: Report filters (and, for a field that is also in Rows or Columns, its hidden items).

items.description: One item label. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

source_col.description: Header name of the source column. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

grand_totals_cols.description: A Grand Total row (a total for each column).

grand_totals_rows.description: A Grand Total column (a total for each row).

id.description: Object id, unique among the objects of the workbook.

last_range.description: The cells the last refresh wrote; `null` = never refreshed.

layout.description: Compact: all row fields in one column, indented. Outline: one column per row field. Tabular: one column per row field, totals below.

name.description: PivotTable name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

rows.description: Fields in the Rows area, outermost first.

items.description: A field placed in the Rows or Columns area.

collapsed_items.description: Labels of the items whose detail is hidden.

items.description: One item label. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

date_group.description: Grouping of a date field (the values are date serial numbers).

sort.description: Order of the items; None = order of first appearance in the source.

source_col.description: Header name of the source column. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

source.description: The source data: range text (`Sheet1!$A$1:$E$200`), a table name or a defined name. Its first row holds the column headers. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

style.description: PivotTable style name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

subtotals_top.description: Subtotals are at the top of each group (Compact and Outline); otherwise below.

func.description: How the records of a report cell are summarised.

name.description: Caption, e.g. `Sum of Sales`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

number_format.description: Number format code of the values; `null` = General. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

show_as.description: A transformation of the summarised value.

source_col.description: Header name of the source column, or the name of a calculated field. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.
